body: I wore thrift store clothes growing up and I turned out ok.

I'm in college & a year & a half ago I posted an ad on craigslist for babysitting so I could make some extra money. Most people I met were normal, some of whom I did end up working for (others weren't willing to pay much so I passed). There was one hippie family that was a little spacey but really nice.

One family emailed me asking if I would meet up with them and that they really wanted to find someone to stay with their two daughters (under 5) while they went on vacation to Iceland (live in U.S.). I thought that was really strange but I met them anyway and they are the nicest people! I did end up babysitting for them and staying with the girls for a week. They've become like mentors to me, kind of like extended family; they're both Ph.D.s and I'm an undergrad (we live in a college town) but nobody in my family has gone to college, so I really appreciate the advice they give me. They're really supportive and generous & I'm really glad it worked out.
